videos.title: Gemini Has A New AI Super App | Here’s How To Master It
videos.ai_tech_id: Google's Gemini desktop app, including the Gemini 4 Argon model and the Antigravity agentic coding environment
summary: Paul J Lipsky gives a full tour of Google's new Gemini desktop app, positioning it as a general-purpose 'super app' that goes well beyond a chat window, covering how to download it and get oriented across its main features.

Chapters walk through Tasks (including running jobs remotely from a phone), local folder access so Gemini can read and work on files on disk, connectors and skills for plugging in outside data and workflows, the built-in Antigravity coding environment, choosing between the Gemini 4 Argon and Flash models for a given job, and a 'Speak to Window' voice-dictation feature for working hands-free.

True to the channel's practical, feature-by-feature tutorial style for AI power users, the video closes by candidly noting what's still missing from the app, giving viewers a realistic sense of its current limits alongside the walkthrough of its capabilities.

videos.title: I Built DM Automations With ChatGPT and Blotato
videos.ai_tech_id: ChatGPT (OpenAI) connected to Blotato via MCP (Model Context Protocol) to build social DM automations
summary: Sabrina Ramonov demonstrates building direct-message automations for Facebook and Instagram entirely inside ChatGPT, connecting Blotato through ChatGPT's MCP settings rather than using a no-code automation platform's own interface.

After the connection is made, she gives ChatGPT a comment keyword, a link, and the message to send, and it builds the DM automation itself, with the added ability to check on or update several existing automations within a single chat conversation.

She flags a practical safety step, double-checking the keyword, link, and message before switching an automation live, and points viewers to a full written walkthrough on her blog, reinforcing the channel's hands-on, reproducible approach to AI business-automation tutorials.

videos.title: 9 AI Skills to Use in Your Business in 2026
videos.ai_tech_id: General-purpose AI assistants and agents (e.g., ChatGPT/Claude-style tools) applied as adoptable business skills rather than a single named product
summary: Sabrina Ramonov reframes AI adoption for small business owners as a set of learnable skills rather than a call to build a standalone 'AI business,' arguing viewers should bring AI into the work they already do.

She runs through nine specific skills: defaulting to asking AI first, applying healthy skepticism to its output, feeding it meaningful context, using it to augment rather than replace human experts, treating it like a new hire that needs onboarding, building a continuously improving feedback loop, maintaining documentation/playbooks/SOPs, giving AI agents tools to act with, and resisting the urge to chase an AI-business idea instead of improving current operations.

The video closes by directing viewers to start with the first skill this week and offers a free companion playlist, consistent with her channel's practical, small-business-focused AI education format.
